Name: Gordon for Mr BlaDe
Author: eleseaHonu
Description:
[center][u][size=4][/size][/u][/center][center][u][size=4]Overview[/size][/u]

[i][size=3]Adds Gordon in all his pixelated glory as a custom companion for BlaDe
[/size][/i][/center]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCnBVj0rivE8iamtAzeziO5Q]Unsurpassable Z[/url]﻿'s recent episode of [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LFsJRg5H7kI&t=5905s]Modded Meadows[/url]﻿ featured several mods by letstrolltheman which are now being released on Nexus.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12031]Mr BlaDe[/url] replaces Mr. Qi with BlaDe sprites, portraits and dialogue.

This mod is intended to be used alongside [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12031]Mr BlaDe[/url].  It adds BlaDe's beloved cat Gordon as a custom companion to both the Casino and Walnut Room where BlaDe (formerly Mr. Qi) appears.  It also includes unique random dialogues when you click on Gordon.


[u][size=3]Config:
[/size][/u]
[list]
[*]"Allow Gordon":  [b]t[/b][b]rue[/b] to spawn Gordon, [b]false[/b] to turn him off.  (Default Value = [i]true[/i]).
[/list]

[u][size=3]Installation:

[/size][/u][list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8626]Custom Companions﻿[/url]﻿
[*]Install the lastest version of Mr Blade
[*]Unzip [b]Gordon for Mr BlaDe[/b] into your mods folder.
[/list]
